scientific_integrity: All infinite statements have an explicit combinatorial and analytic proof. Finite dynamic-programming checks are ancillary rather than substituted for the infinite proof. No claim is made of independent validation.
scientific_limitations: The cyclic-permutation family supplies an explicit upper bound on the minimal entropy rate, not its exact value. The alphabet-two case was previously known. The precise all-target classification for alphabet sizes at least three has not been independently audited, and equivalent unindexed work may exist. General asymptotic bounds of Bukh and Saatashvili for very large alphabet sizes are acknowledged.
title: Cyclic permutation subword extremals and alphabet-dependent entropy bounds
